svg.title: Five fair coin flips with all ten three-head sequences
svg.desc: All 32 equally likely sequences. The ten outlined sequences with exactly three heads are TTHHH, THTHH, THHTH, THHHT, HTTHH, HTHTH, HTHHT, HHTTH, HHTHT, HHHTT. P(X = 3) = 10/32 = 0.3125.

g.text: Five fair flips: all 32 distinct sequences
H = heads (gold) • T = tails (silver) • outlined rows have exactly 3 heads
Exactly 3 heads: 10 distinct sequences; each has probability 1/32.
